title: Parity has maximal coalitional influence
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $J$ be a nonempty set of coordinates among $n$ coordinates. The coalitional influence of the parity function on all $n$ coordinates, with respect to $J$, equals $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite nonempty set of coordinates
